sleeping_bag.name: Magma 15 Sleeping Bag
sleeping_bag.subtitle: current official Magma 15, normalized to medium
sleeping_bag.hood_type: contoured hood with two differentiated drawcords
sleeping_bag.key_features: Medium normalized row; 1009 g total; 661 g of 850-fill water-resistant goose down; ISO-tested; front-wrapping zipper; contoured hood; trapezoidal footbox; includes stuff sack and mesh storage sack.
sleeping_bag.marketing_summary: REI positions the current Magma 15 as a value-forward tested down bag that is heavier than the most exotic ultralight options but competitive on warmth, features and sale price.
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Laboratory-tested warmth, recycled fabrics, water-resistant down and practical comfort details at a more accessible price point.
sleeping_bag.use_cases: General backpacking, cold camp trips and users prioritizing tested warmth and store-backed return support.
sleeping_bag.source_notes: Verified 2026-05-17. Current official product page is the unisex Magma 15. Older men's and women's Magma 15 pages are legacy versions. Official page displayed temporary sale pricing ending 2026-05-25. No verified current FR retailer price found.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: User table weight 1006 g is close to the current medium official weight but not identical; this row stores the current medium official value 1009 g.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: REI 100% satisfaction guarantee plus limited manufacturing-defect support.
sleeping_bag.official_price_text: Official sale pricing observed on 2026-05-17: US$299.19 for short/medium sizes and US$314.19 for long sizes, ending 2026-05-25.
